reason: Same software (Zen Browser) across sources with genuinely different naming — Flathub's short display name "Zen" vs AUR's "zen-browser" family — that no safe name pattern can bridge on its own; zen alone is also now GENERIC_NAME_BLOCKLIST-ed (see group.ts) since it collides with an unrelated AUR C-language tool.
